prose: Clive de Carle is an erudite Englishman with an excellent grasp on the essentials of nutrition, supplements, and strategies for staying out of hospitals. With his Secret Health Club, Clive provides pointers for peak performance that "they" don't want you to know. Tune in to hear empowering health philosophy, learn about Vitamin C, Magnesium, Fulvic minerals, Iodine, willpower, and much more!
